summary: Iteration 4 — Validated new Audit Log feature end-to-end: backend filters (event/user/q/range/from/to), /audit/meta, file.viewed on GET /api/files/{id}, Audit Log frontend page rendering + filters, range-option ORDER on Dashboard/Finance/Audit, and Recharts initial-tooltip suppression on Dashboard+Finance. Backend regression 40/40 PASS; 6 new audit tests 6/6 PASS.

minor.issue: Returns duplicate (user_id, username) pairs when the same username has multiple distinct user_id values historically; causes React 'duplicate key admin' console warning on the audit user filter. Recommend either $group by username only, or frontend should dedupe / use key={u.user_id||u.username}.

action_items: (minor) Dedupe users in /api/audit/meta (group by username) OR change AuditLog.jsx SelectItem key to u.user_id||u.username to remove the React duplicate-key console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: AuditLog.jsx user Select uses `key={u.username}` but /audit/meta can return multiple entries for the same username (distinct user_id + username pairs) → React duplicate-key warning. Safe fix either side.
audit_routes.py `_range_bounds` duplicates the semantics already present in dashboard_routes — worth extracting to a single shared util (DRY) so future range changes apply everywhere.

Carry-over from iter 1/2/3 still open: CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True (invalid per spec); @app.on_event lifecycle deprecated in favour of FastAPI lifespan; /api/auth/change-password blocks new_password==DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD globally (should be scoped to seeded admin account only).
RangePicker.jsx 50ms setTimeout deferring Dialog open is still a magic number — consider chaining off Select's onCloseAutoFocus for deterministic handoff.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Audit feature is production-ready. Range-option DOM order everywhere: today,week,month,6m,year,all,custom. Dashboard+Finance tooltip wrapper is rendered but visibility:hidden with 0x0 size and empty innerHTML on initial mount — verified via getComputedStyle + getBoundingClientRect (screenshots fine, no visible popup). Only residual is the React duplicate-key console warning on the audit user filter — minor. Login/must-change banner/custom-range dialog all continue to work as in iter 3.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing flows this iteration. Note on the 'duplicate key admin' warning: /api/audit/meta aggregates by {user_id, username} to preserve user identity, but admin events from before user_id was attached (or from different admin records) produce multiple {user_id_a, 'admin'}, {user_id_b, 'admin'} tuples. Either collapse to distinct username on the server or key on user_id||username on the client.
